REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION
WEDNESDAY - MARCH 2, 2016 - CITY HALL -
7:00
P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
AGENDA MATERIALS:
Reports and materials related to items on this Agenda are available for public inspection at the Community Development Department, Cerritos City Hall, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA 90703, during normal business hours, 8 a.m.
to 5 p.m., Monday through Friday, Telephone (562) 916-1201. Materials related to an item on this Agenda submitted to the Cerritos Planning Commission after distribution of the
agenda packet are available for public inspection in the Community Development Department at the above address during normal business hours as noted.
PUBLIC COMMENTS:
Public comments will be allowed on all Agenda items at the time
each matter comes up for discussion. The public comments portion of the meeting will not
exceed 45 minutes, and no speaker will be allowed more than five minutes, unless
determined appropriate by the Chair. To assist in the preparation of appropriate
responses, persons are requested to state their name and city of residence for the record.
PUBLIC HEARINGS: Public hearings will be conducted in the order indicated on the
agenda, unless otherwise directed. Conduct of public hearings will occur in substantially
the following sequence: the item to be heard is announced, public hearing is opened, and
report of written correspondence and staff report are received. Verbal testimony will occur
in the following order: those in favor of the application/item, those opposed, interested
parties, rebuttal by applicant. Speakers are requested to state their name and city of
residence for the record. After verbal testimony, the public hearing is closed and the
matter is deliberated with a determination being made or a continuation of the public
hearing.

A.
Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION RECOMMENDING APPROVAL OF PRECISE PLAN 79-12(D)(2016) AMENDMENT, A PROPOSAL BY PROPERTY OWNER BROWNING INVESTMENTS FOR THE FOLLOWING IMPROVEMENTS TO THE CERRITOS ACURA DEALERSHIP: DEMOLITION AND RECONSTRUCTION OF THE EXISTING SHOWROOM AND OFFICE BUILDING AND SERVICE CANOPY; A REMODEL OF THE INTERIOR AND EXTERIOR OF THE EXISTING PARTS AND SERVICE BUILDING; AND REFURBISHMENT OF EXISTING LANDSCAPING THROUGHOUT THE PROPERTY LOCATED AT 18827 STUDEBAKER ROAD. THE SUBJECT PROPERTY IS ZONED DEVELOPMENT AREA FIVE (ADP-5) (APN 7038-012-017).*
*Pursuant to Sections 15301 and 15302 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), this project is categorically exempt from CEQA Review.
AGENDA REPORT
EXHIBIT 21 : COLOR PRESENTATION PACKET
B.
Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION RECOMMENDING THAT THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL APPROVE AND CERTIFY THE NEGATIVE DECLARATION FOR THE PROPOSED CONSTRUCTION OF A WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATION FACILITY UNDER WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATIONS PERMIT 2016-1 (APN 7010-016-022).*
Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION RECOMMENDING APPROVAL OF WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATIONS PERMIT 2016-1, A REQUEST BY APPLICANT CORTEL INC., ON BEHALF OF T-MOBILE WEST CORPORATION, TO CONSTRUCT A 70-FOOT-HIGH MONOPINE (FAUX PINE TREE) WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATION FACILITY. AS PROPOSED, THE MONOPINE WILL CONTAIN NINE (9) PANEL ANTENNAS, NINE (9) REMOTE RADIO UNITS, ONE (1) GLOBAL POSITIONING ANTENNA AND SUPPORT EQUPMENT. ALSO PROPOSED IS ONE (1) FOUR-FOOT-HIGH ELECTRICAL METER PEDESTAL TO BE LOCATED WITHIN THE VICINITY OF THE PROPOSED MONOPINE WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATION FACILITY. THE PROPOSED MONOPINE WILL BE LOCATED ON AN EXISTING INDUSTRIAL DEVELOPMENT AT 16307 ARTHUR STREET IN THE CITY OF CERRITOS. THE SUBJECT SITE IS ZONED DEVELOPMENT AREA ONE (ADP-1) (APN 7010-016-022).
*One Negative Declaration was prepared in accordance with the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) for Wireless Telecommunications Permit 2016-1.

New and Old Business
A.
Review and comment by the Cerritos Planning Commission on an administrative approval of a Minor Precise Plan proposal by Islands Restaurants for a new restaurant in the existing Cerritos Towne Center commercial retail complex. The proposal includes the consolidation of existing tenant spaces into one restaurant tenant space, an enhanced entry tower consistent with the existing shopping center's architectural design, and patio seating. The subject property is located at 12751 Towne Center Drive, Cerritos, California, 90703 and is zoned Development Area Two (ADP-2) (APN 7030-001-027).*
*Pursuant to Section 15301 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), this project is categorically exempt from CEQA Review.
